svg.title: Nine ideas
svg.desc: Nine film frames, one for each idea a run rests on. 1: one right answer is a script's job, and a model does only the language. 2: decide once, before translating, in a film bible every translator starts from. 3: a second reader answers the same questions blind, and what both agree on is locked. 4: the conversation never reads the film; agents get paths and reply with a summary. 5: read it twice, a reviewer against the source and a listener with the Turkish alone. 6: the safety net is code, which drops an edit that adds a problem. 7: a human translator's work is evidence, changed only where something is wrong. 8: meaning before reading speed. 9: an honest report, kept out of the chat.
svg.text: One right answer is a script's job
A model does only the language.
One reader writes the film bible.
Every translator starts from that page.
What both agree on is locked.
The chat never reads the film
Agents get paths and reply in a few lines.
A two-hour film fits in one session.
Read it twice, in two directions
A reviewer reads against the source.
A listener reads the Turkish alone.
A script runs the checks before and after
each edit, and drops one that adds a problem.
changed only where something is wrong.
Filler goes. A clause, a question or a
name never does. The cue stays longer.
An honest report, out of the chat
Open questions wait in the report,
with timestamps, until you have watched.
